FloatingBox variants
|-- Display state and geometry
|   |-- ~ FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|   |-- DisplayState retains panes; arrows are derived from document edges.
|   |-- ~ DisplayState: rootIds + nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane>
|   |-- addDisplayNode links a child; removeDisplayNode prunes its descendants.
|   |-- ~ DisplayNodeBase: childIds + expansion + geometryPolicy + expandedGeometry?
|   `-- Geometry uses unscaled pixels in canvas or viewport space.
|-- Captured selections and projections
|   |-- ~ SelectionRegion: sourceBoxId + sourceContentId + sourceAscii + rect + selectedIds
|   |-- Selection panels retain context; SelectionState controls membership.
|   |-- ~ displayMode: 'stacked' | 'chained'; activeChildId?: string
|   |-- Projection traversal chooses the active branch for stacked presentation.
|   |-- ~ ProjectedPane.content = call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel
|   |-- Source-code panes retain file navigation and saved scroll checkpoints.
|   `-- Live scrolling is managed by SourcePaneViewState.
|-- Conversations and details
|   |-- ~ ConversationPane: thread + draft + presentation + canvasAnchor
|   |-- The canvas anchor remains independent of floating or docked presentation.
|   |-- ~ DetailPane: title + ascii + sectionId?
|   `-- These pane values do not establish ownership of external services.
`-- State transitions and derived placement
    |-- ~ setExpansion(state, id, expansion): DisplayState
    |-- Collapse captures expanded geometry; expansion restores it.
    |-- ~ measureDisplayNode(...) -> updateDisplayGeometry(...)
    |-- Invalid measurements and expanded fixed sizing leave state unchanged.
    |-- ~ FloatingPlacement = connection | grid-region | parent | conversation | stored
    `-- Automatic selections use captured regions; automatic projections use a display parent.
